negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 26932738 - teriparatide did not improve femoral neck fracture healing or reduce revision surgery vs placebo (88% vs 84% revision-free, p=0.743). The fracture-healing use case is a common claim with a null trial behind it.
PMID 39343826 stratifies fracture incidence by renal function - a subgroup where the answer is not uniform.
cautions: The osteosarcoma signal came from rat carcinogenicity work and drove a US boxed warning and a lifetime-use limit that have since changed. Verify the CURRENT label text via openFDA before making any statement about warnings or duration limits.
JOINT-05 is a once-weekly Japanese regimen; do not generalise its effect sizes to daily teriparatide.
